What's your return and refund policy?
Absolutely! Here’s Momcozy’s return and refund policy:
30-day returns: Request within 30 days of delivery, with no explanation required. Items must be new, unused, unopened, in original packaging, and include all accessories, free gifts, and your receipt or order confirmation.
Not eligible: Clearance items and non-Momcozy products. Return shipping is customer-paid, and original shipping fees are non-refundable.
Cancellations: Before shipment, a full refund may be issued. After shipment, follow the return process.
Process: Submit a request at https://momcozy.com/apps/aftership-returns-center. Requests are reviewed within 24 hours, and prior approval is required. Return the item as instructed; insurance is recommended.
Refunds: Approved refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days, or within 3 business days after an approved return is received. Original shipping fees and taxes are deducted.
Exchanges: Unused products may be exchanged within 30 days for non-quality reasons, such as size mismatch; return shipping is customer-paid.
Quality issues: Warranty solutions and warranty refunds, which may be full or partial, depend on approval. Accidental or improper-use damage is excluded, though a replacement discount code may be available with original order details.
